title: Control-aware training of physical neural networks for homeostatic regulation: research software
description: Reproducible research software, held-out evaluation configurations, source data and integrity records accompanying the manuscript 'Control-aware training of physical neural networks for homeostatic regulation'. The release implements project-maintained interferometric and nonlinear coupled-oscillator physics-constrained estimators, robust control-aware training objectives, held-out closed-loop evaluations, task-matched Pareto analysis, decision-regret analysis and an external experimental stress-envelope audit. The archive contains no copied or vendored third-party research source code and does not redistribute third-party binary experimental data.
